description: Create/update/delete an OData entity. Default dryRun=true (preview only). Real write requires writable:true on the base config AND dryRun:false.

dryRun.description: If true (default), return wouldExecute preview without network call. Pass false only when ready to write.

key.description: OData entity key for update/delete, as-is (e.g. guid'...', numeric id). Caller formats key quoting.

name: odata_write
